technique_name: Explain the concept of a ‘Producer-Consumer Problem’
description: The producer-consumer problem is a classic part of computer science and refers to a scenario in which multiple processes share a common communication space such as a buffer. In this scenario, a producer process produces data elements which are input to the buffer and a consumer process reads the data from the same buffer and processes it.
